scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact Fourier moment identities and explicit Poisson synthesis; finite numerical checks are supplementary only. The result has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to one displaced fundamental frequency 0<alpha<1, all integer harmonics n>=2 unshifted, and observation windows of length 2pi.
No claim about arbitrary nonharmonic frequency systems or differentiability of the explicit waveform.
Bibliographic uncertainty remains for older anharmonic oscillation literature, whose entire full texts were not exhaustively inspected.
title: Sharp sign-oscillation threshold for a single displaced fundamental frequency
